claims.claim: This is a Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and Embroidery machine
claims.evidence: Witness could read 'brother' brand but model number/markings near screen were too small to confirm SE630.
Country of manufacture/label not visible or mentioned in witness report.
No power-on test, video, or audio clip of the machine running was captured.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: Not shown in photos; witness explicitly notes accessories, bobbins, needles, hoops, and manual are not visible.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service/usage history cannot be assessed from static photos; purely a seller assertion.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly despite claim of smooth motor
risks.proof: Video clip of machine powering on, threading, and completing a test stitch/embroidery pattern
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/for-parts until proven working

risks.risk: Exact model (SE630 vs a lower/higher model) unconfirmed, affecting value tier
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model label/serial plate on the machine body
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic Brother embroidery machine, lowest plausible tier for the type

risks.risk: Accessories (foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, hoops, manual) may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing all claimed accessories laid out together with the machine

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or mechanical damage on unseen sides (back, underside, needle area)
risks.proof: Additional photos of back, underside, and close-up of needle/bobbin area
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible undisclosed wear or damage

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history despite 'never serviced' claim
risks.proof: Photo of a dated receipt, warranty card, or service record if any exists
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/unknown-age unit with no warranty

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model/serial plate on the machine
Video of the machine powering on and completing a stitch or embroidery sample
Photo of all included accessories (pedal, cord, bobbins, hoops, manual) laid out together
Photos of the back and underside of the machine for hidden wear/damage
Any receipt, warranty card, or proof of purchase/origin, if available
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Brother sewing/embroidery machine, which is enough to price at worst case as an unverified generic unit with no confirmed accessories or working condition; model, origin, and functionality claims remain unproven.
